title: Summarise today's AI work
what: Collects what your AI sessions changed today across branches and worktrees in this repo and writes a short end-of-day summary.
prompt:
Summarise today's AI-assisted work in this repository.

1. List today's commits on every branch with `git log --all --since=midnight --no-merges --stat`, including task branches such as buddy/*.
2. List worktrees with `git worktree list` and note uncommitted changes in each (`git -C <worktree> status --short`).
3. Write an end-of-day summary: what was finished, what is in progress and where, what is waiting for review or a merge, and anything that looks abandoned.
4. Finish with the three most useful things to do first tomorrow.

Keep it under 250 words. Do not change any files.
cost: Low: reads git history and status only.
